newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys two 38,000/T Feb fuel oil at $136-138.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys two 38,000/T Feb fuel oil at $136-138.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has awarded a tender to but two 38,000-tonne cargoes of 0.5-percent sulphur fuel oil for February lifting at $136-$138 a tonne, a CPC official said on Thursday.
CPC had sought one high pour cargo for delivery to Kaohsiung between February 6 and 25 and one low pour cargo for February 1-20 delivery to Keelung or Taichung, cost-and-freight basis.
The official said the high pour cargo was awarded at a lower price than the the low pour material.
In its last tender, CPC bought a total of 76,000 tonnes of 0.5-percent sulphur fuel oil at $149 per tonne for January 1-30 delivery, c-and-f Kaohsiung.
